infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Tabcom uses Bluetooth to discover and connect to nearby Tabcom devices when you enable Discover Nearby.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: Tabcom uses Bluetooth to discover and connect to nearby Tabcom devices when you enable Discover Nearby.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Tabcom uses the local network to upgrade nearby connections to a faster Wi‑Fi link when Discover Nearby is enabled.

plugins.localNetworkUsagePermissionText: Tabcom uses the local network to discover and connect to nearby Tabcom devices when Discover Nearby is enabled.
plugins.bluetoothUsagePermissionText: Tabcom uses Bluetooth to discover and connect to nearby Tabcom devices when you enable Discover Nearby.

plugins.photosPermission: Tabcom needs photo access so you can share images and videos in chats.
plugins.cameraPermission: Tabcom needs camera access so you can capture photos and videos in chats.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Tabcom uses your location only when you choose to share it in a chat, and for Nearby Discovery when you enable it.

plugins.microphonePermission: Tabcom needs microphone access to record voice notes and make calls.
